title: webui.json
description: Settings of the sing-box config generator. Flat since version 2: the profile level and the `defaults` object were removed (see techdocs/architecture.md §8.9). A version-1 file is migrated once by the editor.

version.description: Schema version, bumped only on incompatible changes. 1 was the profile-level form; 2 is flat.

note.description: Free-form comment carried over from settings.yaml. Ignored by the core.

providers.description: State of the discovered provider folders, keyed by the FOLDER NAME under GATEHOUSE_PROVIDERS (the provider identifier). A provider absent from this map is found and DISABLED: its servers are not in the generated config until the owner ticks it. `label` is a human-readable name shown in the editor only — it never reaches tags, keys or config.json.

enabled.description: Whether the provider's servers take part in the generated config. Missing means false.

kind.description: What the folder IS, chosen by the owner: `subscription` reads only links.txt, `awg` reads only *.conf. Missing means «found, not connected»: the folder is listed with a hint but never feeds the config or the tunnels.

label.description: Human-readable name shown instead of the folder name. Trimmed; shown only, never stored in tags or config.json.

suffix.description: Text appended to every server name of this provider after a single space, so two enabled providers handing out identical names stay distinguishable. Empty or missing means the names are exactly as in the links. Added after the in-file duplicate numbering (`… #2 WS`).

overrides.description: Per-subscription corrections that survive a subscription update. Missing keys mean «Авто» (as written in the link). Applied to every server of this provider in one place.

flow.description: XTLS Vision over TCP only: `vision` forces `xtls-rprx-vision`, `none` removes it, missing means «Авто» (from the link). Ignored for ws/grpc/httpupgrade and other non-TCP transports.

fp.description: uTLS fingerprint applied to `tls.utls.fingerprint` of every link of the subscription that carries `tls`. Missing means «Авто» (from the link).

tunnels.description: Tunnels prepared for use: the human-readable name and the file name of the applied `<interface>.conf` in GATEHOUSE_AMNEZIA_DIR. Written when the owner ticks «нужен» in the Providers panel; a tunnel may exist without a proxy. Additive to version 2: a document without the key stays valid.

provider.description: Provider folder the source `.conf` came from. Also the group heading of the System panel.

file.description: Source file name inside the provider folder, with the `.conf` suffix.

name.description: Human-readable name of the tunnel: how it is chosen and edited. Never reaches the kernel, hence the 255 limit of the file system rather than 15.

interface.description: File name of the applied config `<interface>.conf`, the systemd instance `gatehouse-tunnel@<interface>` and the `bind_interface` of the generated outbound. Kernel limit is 15 characters.

policy_routing.description: The tunnel is also handed out through 3proxy by the source address, so the normalised config carries PostUp/PreDown with `ip rule`.

type.description: Kept in sync with PROXY_TYPES of errors.mjs; a test guards the drift.

servers.description: Server tags. An empty or missing list means auto-select. A single string is accepted and normalised by the core, exactly as in the reference.

note.description: Free-form comment. Ignored by the core.

tunnel.description: This proxy IS a tunnel: one inbound plus one `direct` outbound bound to the interface, with no server pool. Mutually exclusive with `servers` — one tunnel, one exit.

provider.description: Provider folder the source `.conf` was taken from. Grouping label of the System panel.

file.description: Source file name inside the provider folder, with the `.conf` suffix.

interface.description: Interface name: the stem of the applied `<interface>.conf`, the unit `gatehouse-tunnel@<interface>` and the `bind_interface` of the generated outbound. Kernel limit is 15 characters.

pinned.description: The exit of this proxy is fixed on purpose. Ignored by the core; enforced by the model: a pinned proxy may name at most one server.

routes.description: Domain routes layered on top of the proxies. Route names carry the same restriction as before: a name made of digits only would be reordered by JavaScript object key rules and would break the byte-for-byte match with the reference.

note.description: Free-form comment. Ignored by the core: buildRules reads only outbound and domains.
